name: Voice Channels
description: Turns channels into always-open voice rooms, using the Calls plugin for audio, video and screen sharing.

settings_schema.header: Voice channels are public or private channels that work like always-open voice rooms. Calls, including audio, video and screen sharing, are handled by the Calls plugin, which must be enabled. See the [documentation](https://docs.antimatter.example/voice-channels) to learn more.

settings.display_name: Join when opening a voice channel
settings.help_text: When true, opening a voice channel from the sidebar joins its call. When false, users join with the Join button of the voice channel.
When true, participants of voice channels can turn on their camera. Video must also be enabled in the Calls plugin settings.
